speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any sputum? If so, what color is it?

speaker: Patient
text: I've been dealing with this cough for over six months, and yes, it produces white phlegm. It seems to get much worse at night and makes it hard for me to keep up with my usual physical activity. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: That duration and the white phlegm suggest a chronic condition; do you have a history of smoking or exposure to dust and chemicals? Also, have you noticed any wheezing or chest tightness when the cough worsens? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms; Pulmonary_Function_Test: FEV1 65% of predicted, FVC 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio 0.60 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging and lung function tests strongly indicate an obstructive pattern consistent with COPD. Do you have a history of asthma, and have you ever been diagnosed with emphysema or chronic bronchitis? DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
